_meta.source: External solution catalogue supplied by the beneficiary, 74 solution entries; sanitised derivative of the attached JSON, Markdown and DOCX files
_meta.method: Allow-listed fields, removal of internal links, names and comments, and deterministic aggregation; stages remain as declared in the source.
_meta.caveat: Generalised catalogue based on external material supplied by the beneficiary. It does not prove implementation, adoption, validation or operational performance at Selgros, and it is not officially issued or approved by Selgros Romania.
assumptions: The benchmark describes requirements and deliverables from the supplied external material; it does not measure Selgros performance.
Mapping to Selgros routes is an independent inference and does not confirm adoption or operational equivalence.

data.name: Stock Age
data.aka: stock age report · stock dataset · ERP ↔ BI reconciliation
data.audience: warehouse Director, Supply Planning, Stock Controlling
data.question: How old is the stock in the warehouses, where it accumulates and how much capital is stuck in goods that don't move?
data.grain: 1 row per item × location × reason code × import date
acceptance: The total of pallets in the report is identical to the total of the ERP extraction for the same date by snapshot.
The amount per item matches the ERP for at least 10 consecutive runs.
The amount per location and the reason code matches the ERP.
A data selector allows comparison with previous days, not just the current day.
The amount of percentage shares per buckets is 100% per each combination of filters.
data.selgros_implementation_status: not confirmed by the external benchmark
data.authorization_status: local analytical use in the context supplied by the beneficiary
